integrity: The all-wheel statement is analytically proved using exact edgewise evaluation profiles and a strict comparison. The embedded rational PDE checker supplies reproducibility but cannot replace proof; independent audit remains unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Only real mean-zero first-order continuous edgewise-H1 functions on equilateral unit-length wheels with unnormalized arclength and Kirchhoff matching. General variable edge lengths, nonuniform measures, and higher-order energies are not established. The prior wheel vertex-resistance identities are explicitly acknowledged.
title: Sharp Sobolev evaluation and rim-midpoint rigidity on metric wheels
